svg.font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Spin-up loads with the trim pumps held and with them working
svg.desc: Two panels, main bearing and hub neck, each showing load as a share of its placeholder limit against spin rate from 0 to 1.5 rpm. With the pumps held the bearing reaches 90 percent and the neck 99 percent of their limits at 0.69 rpm. With the pumps working neither passes 6 percent.
svg.text: Spinning up with the fill's imbalance: pumps held, and pumps working
largest load in each minute, % of the placeholder limit, against spin rate
pumps held: 300, 150 and 80 t left off-centre by the fill are carried all the way up
pumps working once the first crossing is behind, with a dwell at 0.5 rpm
